name: i8-variant-split
description: Shorten an over-budget CI matrix row without losing coverage: split its primary role into new variants that together carry every edge, credit and axis pair the old row carried, verified against the repository's real round resolver, coverage credit, axes rotation and budget. Trigger when a row dies on the deploy cap, on /i8-variant-split, or when the operator asks to split a variant. Infinito.Nexus specific.
